$comment: PROPOSED FOR UPSTREAM. Authored from AOCL v0.1 spec prose (aocl/docs/stacks.md, docs/examples.md) for the aocl v0.2 roadmap item 'Schemas & Validators'. The aocl spec repo ships no schemas/ directory at v0.1; this is a candidate contribution, not a normative artefact yet.
title: AOCL Stack Definition (v0.1)
description: A pipeline or DAG stack definition per docs/stacks.md. Layer ids follow the canonical L<n>.<group>.<name> shape; DAG branch nodes use the BR.<name> shape.
$comment_open: Spec is intentionally open (stacks.md §1: 'AOCL does not require these names'). Custom layer taxonomies and extra config keys are permitted, so additionalProperties is true and the pipeline layer id is a general identifier, matching the hand-rolled validateStack (which only WARNS on non-canonical ids). DAG node ids stay pattern-restricted to canonical L<n>.<group>.<name> or BR.<name> to match validateStack's error-level node check.
